acceptance_criteria.criterion: After runSweep() completes, updateLastActivity() is called with the correct max lastActivity ISO timestamp for each project that has at least one cached repo entry with a non-null lastActivity.
After refreshWorkspace() completes, updateLastActivity() is called with the correct max lastActivity for each project represented in the cache.
Projects where all cached repo entries have null lastActivity are skipped — updateLastActivity() is not called for them.
Cache entries where extractContext() returns an empty object (no ProjectId) are skipped without error.
The runSweep() method itself is not restructured — persistLastActivity() is a separate post-processing step called after the existing fetchWithStagger().
All existing polling manager tests continue to pass.
New unit tests cover: correct max computation across multiple repos/workspaces of the same project, null-activity skip, and extractContext parse-failure skip.
ProjectData interface in project.types.ts includes LastActivity?: string as an optional field.
updateLastActivity() sets LastActivity on the project JSON file and does NOT modify DateModified.
updateLastActivity() short-circuits without writing to disk when the new value equals the existing LastActivity value.
updateLastActivity() silently returns (no error thrown) when called with a project ID that does not exist.
All existing project manager tests continue to pass.
New unit tests in project.manager.test.ts verify all four behaviours above.
All TypeScript imports use .js extensions per the Node16 ESM requirement.

summary: Added private persistLastActivity() method to PollingManager that iterates the in-memory cache, computes the max non-null lastActivity ISO timestamp per project using extractContext() for path→ProjectId resolution, and calls projectManager.updateLastActivity() for each qualifying project.
Called persistLastActivity() after fetchWithStagger() in both runSweep() and refreshWorkspace() — no restructuring of either method.
Added updateLastActivity no-op stub to makeProjectManager() in pollingManager.test.ts and pollingManager.errorLog.test.ts to fix existing tests that now trigger persistLastActivity.

Added 8 new focused unit tests in pollingManager.test.ts covering: correct max after refreshWorkspace, correct max after runSweep, max selection across 3 repos, independent per-project max computation, all-null skip, partial-null handling, and extractContext parse-failure path. All 763 tests pass.

comments.note: persistLastActivity() uses ISO string comparison (lexicographic) to find the max timestamp. This is correct for well-formed ISO 8601 strings (same timezone offset), but a note-worthy assumption. If lastActivity values ever include mixed timezone offsets (e.g. '+05:00' vs 'Z'), the comparison would be incorrect. For the current codebase, git.types.ts defines lastActivity as a git commit timestamp that is always converted to ISO with a consistent offset, so this is safe. Consider adding a brief comment to persistLastActivity() noting this assumption.

In pollingManager.test.ts the makeTrackingProjectManager helper duplicates the list/getById boilerplate from makeProjectManager. These could be unified into a single factory that optionally accepts a tracking callback for updateLastActivity. Not blocking, but worth cleaning up if the test file grows further.

summary: Full verification stack executed against WP-004 (ProjectData.LastActivity + updateLastActivity). All 7 ACs confirmed met. 763 tests pass (0 failures). 4 new updateLastActivity tests verified individually. No regressions detected.
AC1: LastActivity?: string is present in project.types.ts as optional field with correct JSDoc. PASS.

AC2: updateLastActivity() sets LastActivity on the JSON file without touching DateModified — verified by test and direct code inspection (no this.now() call or DateModified assignment in the method body). PASS.
AC3: Short-circuit guard (project.LastActivity === value → return) verified. mtime test confirms no disk write on duplicate value. PASS.
AC4: project not found → early return with no error thrown. doesNotThrow test passes. PASS.
AC5: All 763 pre-existing tests continue to pass. PASS.
AC6: 4 new tests present in project.manager.test.ts covering all 4 behaviours. All pass. PASS.
AC7: All imports in project.manager.ts and project.manager.test.ts use .js extensions. PASS.

Edge-case notes: (1) updateLastActivity accepts any string — no ISO format validation. This is acceptable: the caller (persistLastActivity in pollingManager) already sources from well-formed lastActivity ISO strings. (2) Concurrent writes scenario: multiple processes calling updateLastActivity simultaneously could race on the same file. Not a regression — the manager has always been stateless/disk-based and the same caveat applies to all other write methods.
